page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r5.16xlarge is a memory-optimized instance designed for enterprise applications that demand substantial memory capacity per virtual CPU core. Built on the KVM hypervisor, the instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. It provides 64 dedicated vCPUs and 512.0 GB of memory, establishing a memory ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU core. Network performance includes a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps.

The ecs.r5.16xlarge includes zero integrated GPU accelerators and offers no local disk storage, requiring all persistent data to be hosted on network-attached block storage. This hardware architecture delivers high memory density relative to compute resources, rendering it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring large RAM pools without incurring expenses for local NVMe disks or unused graphics hardware.

Target workload fits for this instance profile include enterprise in-memory databases, large-scale relational database management systems, real-time data analytics, continuous ETL processing, and memory-heavy backend application services.
